week.thesis.egypt: The day is laid on the scale at evening and the pans settle overnight. Seven weighings make the week.
week.thesis.greece: One question goes up to Delphi each day; the week is the art of asking them in order.
week.thesis.canaan: The council convenes each day on one matter; El presides at the seventh and closes the session.
week.thesis.carthage: Seven entries, debits and credits of the sky; the ledger is balanced before the next crossing.
week.thesis.rome: Each day is marked lawful or unlawful for business before it begins; act on the F days.
